# CuriosityFields
> A knowledge-first digital publication exploring science, technology, artificial intelligence, history, astronomy, psychology, and future innovation through long-form, mechanism-level, editorially reviewed articles.

CuriosityFields publishes long-form articles authored and reviewed by the CuriosityFields Editorial Desk, citing named researchers, institutions, and peer-reviewed studies. Content spans seven primary categories and is updated multiple times per week. Last updated: 2026-06-15.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://www.curiosityfields.com/): Featured stories and latest articles across all categories.
- [Categories](https://www.curiosityfields.com/categories): Browse all topic hubs.
- [About](https://www.curiosityfields.com/about): Editorial mission, standards, and team.
- [Contact](https://www.curiosityfields.com/contact): Reach the editorial team.
- [Write For Us](https://www.curiosityfields.com/write-for-us): Contributor guidelines and accepted topics.

## Categories
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://www.curiosityfields.com/categories/artificial-intelligence): AI models, agents, infrastructure, bias, and societal impact.
- [Technology](https://www.curiosityfields.com/categories/technology): Computing, internet infrastructure, security, and digital systems.
- [Science](https://www.curiosityfields.com/categories/science): Biology, genetics, physics, and emerging research.
- [Astronomy](https://www.curiosityfields.com/categories/astronomy): Cosmology, space exploration, and astrophysics.
- [History](https://www.curiosityfields.com/categories/history): Civilisations, archaeology, and historical turning points.
- [Psychology & Mind](https://www.curiosityfields.com/categories/psychology-mind): Cognitive biases, neuroscience, and behavioral science.
- [Future Innovation](https://www.curiosityfields.com/categories/future-innovation): Emerging technologies and forward-looking science.

## Cornerstone Articles: How Things Actually Work
- [How AI language models confidently state false facts](https://www.curiosityfields.com/article/why-ai-language-models-confidently-state-false-facts-mechanism): The mechanism behind AI hallucination, explained.
- [What a context window actually means in AI](https://www.curiosityfields.com/article/what-context-window-actually-means-ai-limit): Why AI models forget information mid-conversation.
- [How social feed ranking algorithms work](https://www.curiosityfields.com/article/how-social-feed-ranking-algorithm-works): The mechanics behind what you see on social platforms.
- [How Google indexes 130 trillion pages](https://www.curiosityfields.com/article/how-google-indexes-130-trillion-pages-crawling-architecture): The crawling architecture behind modern search.
- [AlphaFold and the protein folding breakthrough](https://www.curiosityfields.com/article/alphafold-protein-folding-explained): How AI solved a 50-year biology problem.
- [Why Incognito mode doesn't make you anonymous](https://www.curiosityfields.com/article/incognito-mode-doesnt-hide-you-online-privacy): What private browsing actually protects, and what it doesn't.
